data.narrative:
Radify Metals is a Robotics & Manufacturing company at an undisclosed stage founded by Zach Detweiler, Dan Bullard, Bryce Parrish, and Zach Murphree. The valuation universe consists of 10 peers operating in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, comprising one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

Peer-median valuation methodology was inapplicable to this analysis. Despite identifying ten same-sector comparables, the absence of sufficient peers matching Radify's stage, adjacent-stage cohort, or valuation tier precluded reliable triangulation via this method. Filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-valuation-tier comparables each yielded fewer than three datapoints, falling below the minimum threshold of three required for defensible peer benchmarking. An all-sector median would introduce excessive noise and misrepresent true comparability.

Without applicable triangulation methods, no valuation range can be supported by this data. Additional disclosure regarding Radify's funding stage, prior fundraising, and revenue metrics would enable narrowing the peer set to stage-matched or revenue-scaled comparables. The current dataset identifies the relevant sector ecosystem but lacks the specificity required for quantitative valuation synthesis. A revised analysis upon availability of stage and financial data would permit coherent peer selection and multiples-based valuation anchoring.
